title: The Open/Closed Gromov-Witten/Hurwitz Correspondence and Localized World Sheets for Completed Cycles
summary: We discuss the open/closed version of the Gromov-Witten/Hurwitz correspondence. The duality equates the relative Gromov-Witten invariants and the count of covers of the target space with prescribed holonomies at boundaries. We clarify the projective large N limit as well as the role of the completed versus the ordinary cycles associated to the bulk and the boundary vertex operators respectively.
